instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in your right hand.
2. Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is fully extended.
3. Step forward with your right foot and lower until both knees bend to about 90 degrees.
4. Push through your front heel to return to standing, keeping the dumbbell locked overhead.
5. Finish all reps on one side, then switch arms and legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the working arm locked out and the dumbbell stacked over your shoulder.
2. Brace your core to stop your torso leaning toward the loaded side.
3. Keep your chest up and front shin near vertical.
4. Inhale as you descend, exhale as you stand.
name: Dumbbell single arm overhead lunge

instructions:
1. Lie on your back, arms and legs spread wide in a star shape, dumbbell in your right hand.
2. Keep your left hand and right leg on the floor.
3. Brace your core and lift your left leg and right arm at the same time toward each other.
4. Reach the dumbbell toward your left foot and squeeze your abs at the top.
5. Lower under control to the start, finish all reps, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the movement from your abs, not your neck.
2. Move slowly and controlled in both directions.
3. Keep the resting arm and leg pressed to the floor for balance.
4. Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Single Arm Starfish Crunch

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in your right hand using an underhand grip, palm facing forward.
2. Let the arm hang straight at your side.
3. Raise the dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height with a near-straight arm.
4. Pause when your arm is parallel to the floor.
5. Lower under control to the start, finish all reps, then switch arms.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a slight, fixed bend in the elbow.
2. Lift with the front shoulder, not a swing from the hips.
3. Brace your core to keep your torso still.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Single Arm Underhand Front Raise

instructions:
1. Stand with your right side to a wall, right hand on the wall, a dumbbell in your left hand.
2. Lift your right foot off the floor and balance on your left leg.
3. Press through the ball of your left foot to raise your heel as high as possible.
4. Pause and squeeze the calf at the top.
5. Lower the heel under control to the start.
6. Repeat, then switch sides.
tips:
1. Move slowly and get full range at the top and bottom.
2. Keep your supporting knee straight to bias the gastrocnemius.
3. Stay upright and use the wall only for balance.
4. Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise Wall Support

instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
2. Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot slightly off the floor.
3. Hinge at the hips, extending your right leg straight behind you as the dumbbells lower toward the floor.
4. Keep a slight bend in your left knee and a straight line from head to right heel.
5. Drive through your left heel to stand back up, keeping the right foot off the floor.
6. Repeat, then switch sides.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat and hinge from the hips, not the lower back.
2. Fix your eyes on a point ahead to hold balance.
3. Brace your core to stop your hips and torso rotating.
4. Exhale as you stand, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift
